review_candidates.description: The Chief Executive Officer is an accomplished, relationship-driven leader with expertise in mobilizing capital, building and stewarding institutional relationships, stakeholder engagement, and organizational growth, paired with a strong commitment to Hawaiʻi and its communities. ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Hawaiʻi Community Lending (HCL) is a nonprofit Native Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and licensed mortgage lender and servicer dedicated to expanding access to credit and capital for Native Hawaiians and other underserved communities throughout Hawaiʻi. Founded in 2002 and independent since 2014, HCL grew from a community-driven effort to address barriers to affordable homeownership into a sophisticated, statewide community development finance institution. Guided by the philosophy of kahua waiwai , or “foundation of wealth,” HCL views stable housing and financial security as foundations for family stability, cultural connection, community well-being, and intergenerational prosperity. Its model combines flexible lending with financial education, technical assistance, and long-term relationships with borrowers and community partners. HCL has established an affordable homeownership system that provides financing for homebuilders to homebuyers to homeowners including debt consolidation and credit builder loans, mortgage and construction financing, home repair and rehabilitation, and small business lending. The organization has developed specialized expertise in financing homes on Hawaiian Home Lands, supporting families facing financial hardship, preserving homeownership, and filling gaps left by conventional lenders. Since its inception, HCL has helped more than 6,500 Hawaiʻi households access over $203 million in grants, loans, and mortgage financing. Its capacity to respond at scale was demonstrated during COVID-19, when HCL was entrusted with approximately $40 million to help thousands of families avoid foreclosure and eviction, and more recently through its support for families and communities affected by the Lahaina wildfires and Kona Low, Lala, and Lowell tropical storms. Today, HCL is well-positioned to scale dramatically in its next chapter. The organization has grown from a $3 million fund in 2020 to approximately $25 million and has built the lending, servicing, financial, and organizational infrastructure needed for accelerated growth. With deep community relationships, experienced leadership, and growing local and national recognition, HCL has the potential to become a $100+ million fund within five years while maintaining strong financial performance and meaningful community impact. This growth would enable HCL to mobilize significantly more capital, reach more families, strengthen a new affordable homeownership system, and demonstrate the power of mission-driven finance to create lasting economic opportunity and prevent outmigration of Hawaiʻi residents. ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY The Chief Executive Officer will lead HCL into its next chapter, building upon a strong foundation while helping define the organization’s ambition, reach, and influence for years to come. This is an opportunity to lead a distinctive financial institution at the intersection of affordable homeownership, community development, and economic opportunity, and to shape how capital can be deployed more effectively to serve Hawaiʻi’s families and communities. In partnership with the Board and executive team, the CEO will establish HCL's strategic direction, translate it into clear priorities and measurable results, and ensure HCL has the leadership, resources, and organizational capacity to grow responsibly. A central mandate will be to expand and diversify the capital available to HCL, strengthening the financial foundation for its next phase of growth. The CEO will be a trusted and highly visible representative of HCL to banks, investors, foundations, corporations, government agencies, Native Hawaiian institutions, and other mission-aligned partners. Grounded in credibility, authenticity, and a deep understanding of HCL’s mission, the CEO will open doors to new sources of capital, innovative financing opportunities, and strategic partnerships. The successful candidate will be energized by bringing people and institutions together around a compelling purpose and inspiring confidence in HCL’s vision and continued growth. The CEO will also guide HCL’s strategic expansion, identifying opportunities to extend its reach while maintaining the financial strength, risk discipline, and community accountability that have enabled its success. Building on HCL’s established lending platform, the CEO will advance opportunities in affordable homeownership, housing and construction finance, small business lending, and other areas where flexible, mission-driven capital can address unmet need. The leader will bring an enterprise perspective to growth, balancing opportunity with financial sustainability and ensuring that new initiatives are supported by the appropriate capital, infrastructure, talent, and capabilities. As HCL’s chief external voice, the CEO will elevate the organization’s profile and influence locally and nationally, helping shape the broader policy and financing environment in which HCL operates. The role will include engaging policymakers, public agencies, Native Hawaiian institutions, community leaders, funders, financial institutions, and industry partners to advance policies and resources that expand access to housing and capital. Internally, the CEO will foster a high-performing, collaborative culture, partner effectively with the Board and executive team, and ensure the organization remains focused on both strong performance and meaningful community outcomes. Ultimately, the opportunity is to help shape not only HCL’s future, but the broader ecosystem of capital and opportunity available to Hawaiʻi’s communities. The ideal candidate will be an accomplished, highly relational executive who combines strategic vision, financial acumen, and executive leadership with a genuine commitment to Hawaiʻi and its communities. They will have demonstrated success mobilizing capital, building and stewarding institutional relationships, leading through an experienced executive team, and working effectively with a Board and diverse external stakeholders. Candidates may come from banking, community development finance, affordable housing, commercial or mortgage lending, impact investing, philanthropy, economic development, or another mission-driven financial environment; direct CDFI experience is valuable but not essential. Above all, HCL seeks a leader who leads with integrity and cultural humility, earns trust authentically, and is inspired by the opportunity to use capital, relationships, and leadership to create greater housing and economic opportunity for generations of Hawaiʻi families. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. We're looking for a Technical Support Senior Associate to join our Customer Operations Tech Support team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help customers resolve technical issues and get the most out of Pleo, with a strong focus on troubleshooting technical issues and bugs and reporting them to product teams. If you're excited about working in a dynamic environment and are passionate about delivering excellent technical support, this is the opportunity for you. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to the Tech Support Lead and work closely with teams in Product and Engineering (and other relevant departments) to prioritise fixes and improvements. What You’ll Be Doing As a Technical Support Senior Associate, you will: Provide timely technical support to customers via Freshdesk, resolving issues and answering product questions. Navigate Freshdesk proficiently, using them to troubleshoot, document, and guide users through problem-solving. Troubleshoot technical issues using solid technical understanding, and communicate solutions clearly to non-technical users. Stay up to date on Pleo products so guidance is accurate and current. Collaborate with product teams to report issues, contribute context, and help prioritise bug fixes and enhancements. Manage and escalate bugs appropriately, including setting clear expectations on timelines and managing user expectations. Drive improvements proactively, identifying areas to optimise support workflows and implementing changes independently where possible. Provide regular updates to the Tech Support Lead on ongoing issues, challenges, and improvement opportunities. To put things into context, we currently have needs input on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tools and stack: Freshdesk Freshchat Slack Big Query Postman Grafana Pleo internal tools and systems What You Bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 1+ years of experience in a first-line support role (or equivalent experience), handling diverse technical queries. Proven expertise in navigating Freshdesk and Freshchat. Solid technical acumen, with the ability to troubleshoot effectively. Familiarity with Big Query (or similar reporting/BI tools). Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. A quick learning mindset, picking up new topics and technologies rapidly. A proactive, self-motivated approach, focused on driving positive change in support processes. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You enjoy solving technical problems and helping customers succeed. You are confident working in Freshdesk and Slack and keeping communication clear and structured. You like collaborating cross-functionally and influencing product improvements through support insights. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer not to work directly with customers on technical troubleshooting. You are uncomfortable prioritising, escalating, and following up on bugs with product teams. You prefer fixed processes and do not enjoy improving workflows. Show Me The Benefits. Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work About Your Application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here. Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
